allow_instructions: Allow project-local unit, integration, lint, typecheck, formatting, and build commands when they do not target production or mutate protected infrastructure.
Allow the framework validation and status scripts under scripts/ai-team/.
block_instructions: Require explicit approval for any command that pushes directly to main, master, trunk, or another protected branch.
Require explicit approval for destructive Git history operations such as force push, reset --hard, or deleting protected branches.
Require explicit approval for production deployments or commands targeting a production environment.
Require explicit approval for production database writes, destructive migrations, or data deletion.
Require explicit approval for Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud, IAM, permission, secret, or credential mutations.
Require explicit approval for destructive filesystem commands such as recursive deletion outside build/temp directories.
